brief.t: Terra Lotus, seventy-eight thousand five hundred eighty dollars, is still our biggest lever and Aidan has been silent on the volume pricing all week. My WhatsApp is logged out right now, so I can't post the escalation or see if he replied — reconnecting it is the one thing that unblocks it.

The Kenna deals are still one confirmation from you: tell me the Atlas Eternal formula came through Wednesday and I log Atlas into production, and say go and I build the full Milk of Venus thousand-unit quote Aidan already has the fill size and price target for.
Susan at Salty Pup pinged you last night asking for an update on the dog rinse — sixteen ounce bottles, four hundred labels for the first batch. She's waiting on the next step from you.
Laura's team approved the Miron violet-glass quote and wants to move forward and pay by card — make sure Aidan gets that order placed so the packaging doesn't hold up the project.

Weekend inbound: Mohammed Al Aamri of Dhofar Frankincense in Oman came in through the website, and Monday is filling up — Tesfa at Bahrzaf on the shampoo and conditioner Monday, plus Darlene Saintil's luxury hand-care discovery Wednesday.

Two sessions are logged out and blocking me: WhatsApp for the client sweep and Terra Lotus, and the CRM for developer-fix verification and the purchasing knowledge base. Reconnecting both clears the most work fastest.
Ads are still one word from you — say revert ads to manual and I flip both campaigns off Maximize Conversions. The cache refreshed clean this morning and the Google Ads connection is live.

kb.a: Milk of Venus is Kenna's thousand-unit order: one hundred eighteen milliliter fill, price target six to eight dollars per unit. Aidan and Kenna are actively working the numbers by email. Next step is the full quote — ingredients plus packaging, labor, and overhead — once Sam gives the go.

Sam's single lane today: reconnect WhatsApp and the CRM session (both logged out), confirm the Atlas formula from Wednesday's Kenna meeting and green-light the Milk of Venus quote, and reply to Susan at Salty Pup. Terra Lotus stays Aidan's lane, silent all week.

Terra Lotus is our biggest deal at seventy-eight thousand five hundred eighty dollars, fifty-two percent of the monthly target. Aidan owns the volume-pricing conversation and has been silent all week. WhatsApp is logged out, so the escalation and reply-check are blocked until it's reconnected. Deposit is thirty-nine thousand two hundred ninety dollars on signing.

Atlas Eternal is twenty-six thousand five hundred dollars for five thousand units. The thirteen thousand two hundred fifty dollar deposit is paid; the balance is due on completion. Production kicks off the moment Sam confirms the formula is in hand from Wednesday's Kenna meeting — no confirmation has come in yet.

Pure Good is roughly three hundred twenty-nine thousand dollars and advances off the same Kenna relationship. With the Kenna meeting now done, the next step is to schedule Pure Good's follow-up and quote.

Ashley Harmon at Apothik Skin replied this morning: she's booked tomorrow and will send call times for next week for the postbiotic moisturizer and balm project, one to three thousand units per SKU. Still warm — just a short delay before it's on the calendar.

Tasnim Broud at AYYUR is deciding on packaging for the ritual oil: a thirty milliliter frosted glass bottle with a gold dropper and cap. She doesn't have a vendor locked in and is open to PLL sourcing it. Keep moving her toward the three prototypes at two hundred fifty, five hundred, and a thousand units.

Nabil Saleh at CN1 Fragrance still wants four thousand-plus eight-ounce tubes of scented body lotion with his own fragrance oil supplied. No new reply in the sweep — still open to qualify formula, packaging, and timeline toward a quote.

Raul Guardado approved the final Struck Box version-five printing and asked for a status update. Laura already replied yesterday: we're waiting on a proof from the printer and will send it the moment it arrives. No action needed from Sam right now.
Charles Thompson at Brighten Path flagged that his beard balm and body wash samples never arrived. Carryover customer-care item — chase the shipment so it doesn't sour a live prospect.

Both net-new campaigns are on Maximize Conversions with no conversion tracking. One word from Sam, revert ads to manual, and the Consultant has the Ads Agent flip both to Manual CPC. The Ads cache refreshed clean this morning and the Google Ads connection is live; the weekly revert recommendation is preserved pending Sam's yes.

The production workflow is finalized: Sam approved the node-and-arrow flow map and a GMP sign-off page was added, now a nine-page package. It's done — say go and the Consultant builds the live CRM Production Pipeline.
Oreka, Nadia Dupuis, is closed and in production — eight thousand five hundred fifty-five dollars paid, thousand-unit peptide cream. Laura owns customer communication. No action needed.

The CRM browser session is logged out, which blocks live verification of developer fixes, Shopify sync, and the purchasing knowledge-base extraction. Sam logging back in as pll_tasklet_consultant unblocks all of it. No CRM developer replies came in overnight.

Victor Armendarez needs costing on two thousand units each of a curl-defining cream and an edge gel. It's overdue on Ronald's cost inputs — ingredients plus packaging, labor, and overhead before any quote goes out.

The OpenSend outbound engine is designed and waiting on Sam: buy three lookalike domains and a sending platform, create the separate Outbound Agent with its own login and memory off, and provide a booking calendar URL. Cold email only, never on the main domain; no cold texting.

Two sessions are logged out: the Consultant's WhatsApp (blocking the client sweep and the Terra Lotus escalation) and the CRM (blocking developer-fix verification, Shopify sync, and the purchasing knowledge base). Reconnecting both clears the most work fastest. Aidan's own WhatsApp and CRM are separately signed out on his machine.

Melissa Hilger of Busy Bee Vitality submitted a new skincare inquiry through the website contact form overnight (August thirteenth, 9pm). It's unqualified and not yet tied to any ad campaign — worth a quick follow-up today to see what she needs.

The Farmington Hills facility passed its final re-occupancy building and fire inspections on August thirteenth — both approved. UPS, USPS, and Shopify address changes and test-label/order paths in each system still remain pending; no new evidence yet that those were completed.

Susan Trudeau at Salty Pup pinged Sam last night asking for an update on the after-beach dog rinse — sixteen ounce bottles, four hundred labels for the first batch. She's waiting on the next step; owes her a reply to keep it moving.
Laura's team approved the Miron violet-glass quote and wants to move forward and pay by card. Aidan/purchasing should place the order so the packaging doesn't hold up the project.
Mohammed Al Aamri of Dhofar Frankincense in Oman came in through the website contact form on August fourteenth — a new international B2B inquiry. Unqualified so far; worth a qualifying reply.

Darlene Saintil booked a PLL discovery meeting for Wednesday August nineteenth at 4pm — a luxury hand lotion and hand wash line, clean sensitive-skin-friendly scent, with an allocated budget. Warm lead via Laura.
Tesfa Shiferaw at Bahrzaf has a shampoo and conditioner project; Sam is set to talk with him Monday. Discovery call booked.
